limitations: Prescribed axisymmetric geometry; no motion, rim evolution, sixfold branching, surface diffusion, nucleation stochasticity, aggregation or fracture.
Outer Dirichlet boundary stays finite and is refined separately from the grid.
Molecular jumps and ventilation absent. Isothermal-crystal latent heating is optional and omits a substrate heat sink.
Sharp-corner sample values require mesh refinement; corner extrapolation is numerical evidence, not a measured tip radius.
Published broad/narrow attachment parameter limits do not define an autonomous interpolation in rim width.

patches: Remove exactly two unused scratio_a/c assignments reading uninitialized scrat_low/hi.
Extract routines after the published main program for the shared library.
Replace only spheroid capacitance arithmetic with equivalent factored eccentricity/asin and asinh forms.
attachment_build.wrapper: C-double interface converts inputs to native REAL; original coefficient operations unchanged.
source_limits: Characteristic-supersaturation fits guarded to -70 through -1 C; m in [1,15].
Native coefficients have an existing floor of 1e-6.
No ventilation input; assumes source air transport properties.
Source metadata requires annual notification of customization; no notification sent.
attachment_build.evidence: Compiled published component; native demo is a numerical reference, not empirical validation.

limits: Rims and cavity depth are unmeasured sensitivity inputs; no choice is a reconstruction.
Independent mass and axis fits have no supplied derivative errors.
JW is a common conductance multiplier; the flow around the actual hollow crystal is not resolved.
Cylinder normal rates are compared with fitted half-maximum spans; hexagonal coordinate and profile effects remain.
Changing Harrington mechanism while retaining its critical supersaturation is an explicit sensitivity.
Observed dimensions and rim are supplied at each time; the calculation predicts neither geometry nor rim evolution.
The fixed cavity depth is half the observed semilength; cavity interior is inactive.
Trapezoidal integration uses observation times; mesh refinement is separate from unknown temporal interpolation error.
Supplied endpoint-error sums bound measurement perturbations, not forcing, projection or substrate uncertainty.
Isothermal free-crystal heat loss excludes substrate conduction; no air circulation is modeled.

evidence: Prescribed-shape Earth tests and transport feasibility; no fitted parameters, autonomous habit validation or lunar size forecast.
limitations: Uniform local uptake is a hypothesis. A failed check does not exclude uniform facet advance sustained by nonlocal surface transport.
M1 is a proposed narrow-facet law, not a complete width-dependent model. The broad limit and printed-log ambiguity are kept separate.
The 2023 photos are selected examples, not an unbiased population distribution; no pixel data are inferred here.
